label: T2-06
statement: Statins with a high degree of lipophilicity eg. simvastatin may be associated with central nervous system disturbance eg. sleep disturbance, nightmares. Consider more hydrophilic statins eg. atorvastatin, pravastatin in people with SMI

preambles.text: OPTIMISE is a 62 indicator medicines optimisation tool designed to assist decision making in those treating adults with SMI.

People with severe mental illness (SMI), including schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, bipolar illness and severe affective disorder have a life expectancy up to 30 years shorter than those without SMI [1–4].
